description:
I would like to replace the existing, single glazed timber white window frames (x5) at the front of the house, which are old and have degraded in functionality, with “like for like” new timber white window frames with double glazing. In total this would include 2 windows on the ground floor and 3 on the first floor.

I have received a quote from the provider for Timber Casement Hardwood windows for the ground floor living room (front only), ground floor garage/study, first floor hall, first floor bedroom right, first floor bedroom left. Detailed designs, dimensions and materials to be used are included in this application, including pictures of existing windows for comparison.

Recognizing that I live in a conservation area, I believe that replacing the windows, will not only have beneficial impact on energy efficiency of the house, but will also enhance the appearance of the front of the house, as a number of other neighbors have renovated and improved their windows in recent years. My family have owned / lived in the house for over 15years now, with these windows, and now would like to improve and upgrade these. We are also struggling to properly open/close the windows from the inside, which is another reason for wanting to modernize and replace the windows.

At a high level the quote from the supplier includes the following specification:

Frames: TIMBER - TRAD Casement - Hardwood P
Glazing: Clear Tuff Low E 22mm Astragal Warm Edge Spacer White ARGON Hotmelt
Specification: Handle: Handle - WHITE; Hinge: Std Hung Hinges and Butt Hinges; Lock: Shootbolt Lock; 
Frame Finish Ext: WHITE PAINTED
Cill: 150mm Cill Hardwood
Outer Frame: O/Frame Hardwood
